# Degraded availability for GPT-6 Luna in Copilot

## What Changed

Nov 19, 16:37 UTC Resolved - On November 19, 2026, between 15:38 and 16:18 UTC, GitHub Copilot requests using the GPT-6 Luna model experienced degraded availability. During this time, an average of 45% of GPT-6 Luna requests failed, peaking at 63%. Copilot Fusion Max was also temporarily unavailable during this incident. Users could continue using Copilot by selecting a different model. The degradation was caused by an issue with an upstream model provider. GitHub engineers detected the issue through automated monitoring, worked with the provider to resolve it, and restored full service. Error rates returned to normal by 16:18 UTC, and Copilot Fusion Max was available again by 16:25 UTC. We are working to improve the availability of Copilot Fusion against such model provider outages in the future. Nov 19, 16:28 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Copilot AI Model Providers has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 19, 15:57 UTC Update - We are experiencing degraded availability for the GPT-6 Luna model in Copilot products and IDE surfaces. This is due to an issue with an upstream model provider.
